method: Native Bonsai on one lowest-ProteinEBM-energy model per assigned cluster plus up to five explicit low-energy unassigned examples; extra next-lowest-energy cluster members reach eleven leaves where needed; full-construct accepted 4096-dimensional all-pair sketch; all nonzero PCA axes; no whitening or variance scaling.
scope: CDK2_DOC1t · A1-298+B1-55 · knn; joint 5,000-model full-construct fit, view-specific energy representatives and labeled extras. Energy selection does not imply structural centrality.
